## Sales Performance Review FY2025

Commercial Excellence

## 1. Highlights

FY2025 order intake reached EUR 448.5 million. Service revenue grew 14.1% and now represents 19.8% of sales. The largest single order was EUR 5.4 million from Larsson Foods AB.

## 2. Regional performance

Revenue by sales region:

| Region | Revenue FY2025 | Growth | Win rate | Regional lead |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Nordics | EUR 51.1m | 0.5% | 28% | Alexa Schlager |
| DACH | EUR 105.0m | 13.3% | 28% | Éléonore Camus |
| Iberia | EUR 83.0m | 12.8% | 27% | Tymoteusz LizoI |
| France & Benelux | EUR 101.5m | 12.1% | 31% | Éléonore Camus |
| Central & Eastern Europe | EUR 57.3m | 10.6% | 33% | Zora KrejIová |

## 3. FY2026 priorities

Raise win rate in DACH, launch SmartFlow 2.0 bundles and open the Stockholm office. - Jarmo Pesonen, CCO
